topPRs.title: feat(sdm): post-exec (0x7D) tx + SDM warming-refund accounting, gated by flag
topPRs.author: nonsense
topPRs.body:
This PR is introducing SDM - Sequencer-Defined Metering.

Design doc: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/blob/main/protocol/sdm.md
Tracking issue: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19779

PR is heavy WIP, and ideally will be refactored further so that it is easier for review.

---

Follow-up from https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19954

---

### Per-commit summaries

  **feat(op-alloy): add post-exec (0x7D) transaction type**
  Hardened post-exec transaction already included in previous PR.

  **feat(alloy-op-evm): post-exec block executor and SDM warming inspector**
  Core consensus change. `SDMWarmingInspector` tracks first-warmer provenance
   and emits refunds.

  **feat(op-reth): add ConfigurePostExecEvm and post-exec-aware evm config**
  Plumbing for `op-reth`

  **feat(op-reth): inject synthetic post-exec tx in payload builder**
  Appends the 0x7D tx at block tail when `--rollup.sdm-enabled`.

  **feat(op-reth): add debug_replaySDMBlock rpc and post-exec-replay crate**
  New `reth-optimism-post-exec-replay` crate re-executes a historical block under `Produce` and compares the synthesized payload to the embedded `0x7D` and the receipt-level refund projection.

  **feat(op-chain-ops): add Go sdmreplay client**
  Go driver for `debug_replaySDMBlock`

  **test(op-acceptance-tests): add end-to-end SDM coverage**
  Devstack tests that boot an `op-reth` sequencer with SDM enabled.

  **feat(op-reth): add SDM observability metrics**
  SDM observability

---

TODO:
- [ ] simplify further and leave only mandatory changes, by extracting nice-to-have functionality and tools for future PRs.

topPRs.author: axelKingsley

Add --interop.log-backfill-depth to pre-ingest initiating logs from T_lo = max(activation, tip - depth) through local safe. ChainContainer gains TimestampToBlockNumber. Backfill and T_lo math live in log_backfill.go (run loop, ceiling snapshot, skip-verify gating). SkipPersistFrontierLogs on advance when logs were backfilled. Config validation and table-driven tests; log_backfill_test.go covers bounds + integration.

topPRs.title: feat: zk opcm go
topPRs.author: ashitakah
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Wires `ZK_DISPUTE_GAME` into the Go deployer upgrade path, enabling `op-deployer` to encode and pass ZK game configurations to `OPContractsManagerV2` during chain upgrades.

---

## Changes

### `upgrade/embedded/upgrade.go`

- Added `GameTypeZKDisputeGame = 10` constant
- Added `ZKDisputeGameConfig` struct with all 5 fields (`absolutePrestate`, `verifier`, `maxChallengeDuration`, `maxProveDuration`, `challengerBond`)
- Added `zkEncoder` with the ABI signature matching the Solidity struct
- Added case `GameTypeZKDisputeGame` in `EncodedUpgradeInputV2` with nil config validation and error propagation

### `upgrade/embedded/upgrade_test.go`

- Exact ABI hex encoding verification for a ZK game config
- Validation test: enabled ZK game with nil `ZKDisputeGameConfig` returns error
- Disabled ZK game encodes correctly with empty `gameArgs`

---

## Pipeline / Addresses

- **`devfeatures.go`** — added `SuperRootGamesMigrationDevFlag` constant
- **`opcm/implementations.go`, `opcm/opchain.go`, `pipeline/implementations.go`, `pipeline/opchain.go`** — wired `zkDisputeGameImpl` address through the pipeline structs
- **`op-chain-ops/addresses/contracts.go`, `interopgen/deployments.go`** — registered ZK impl in the shared contract address maps
- **`ReadImplementationAddresses.s.sol`** — reads `zkDisputeGameImpl` from the OPCM container when V2 flag is active
